paper: Signal or Noise in Multi-Agent LLM-based Stock Recommendations?
claim_boundary: A researcher-authored monthly U.S.-stock analogue of MarketSenseAI's News, Fundamentals, Dynamics, and Macro specialists, adaptive synthesis, five-class recommendation, and strongest-buy universe filter; not the unreleased live recommendations, texts, embeddings, or fixed-cohort portfolios.

paper_source.bounded_release_search_checked_2026_09_0: Exact paper and implementation searches expose the paper, summaries, and a research-only not-implemented record, but no attributable recommendation panel or runtime.

primary_source_anchors.mechanism: News, Fundamentals, Dynamics, and Macro specialists independently analyze each stock before a synthesis agent emits a thesis and five-point ordinal recommendation.
Recommendations are formed monthly and one-month forward returns evaluate a strongest-buy equal-weight portfolio within fixed S&P 500 and S&P 100 cohorts.
The headline signal is the rare strongest-buy class, averaging 7.5% of S&P 500 stock-dates, not the downstream NNLS explanation.
NNLS shows specialist contributions rotate by stock, sector, and market regime, motivating context-dependent rather than fixed synthesis weights.

synthesis_and_recommendation_policy.specialist_primitive: reuse the transparent four-specialist numerical MarketSenseAI primitive from M016, but not its final portfolio or result
synthesis_and_recommendation_policy.common_portfolio_adapter: the five-class ordinal score plus synthesis tie-break enters frozen value-weighted long-short deciles and all six common paths; the upper tail represents strongest buys

preserved_elements: continuous specialist attribution as a secondary diagnostic
approximated_elements: signed JKP features replace live news, filings, prices, and macro text
rolling historical RankIC replaces thesis-embedding NNLS for adaptive synthesis
a six-month market-return regime proxy supplies macro context
fixed percentile boundaries replace unreleased five-class synthesis prompts
the reported 7.5% S&P 500 strongest-buy frequency fixes the top-tail size
ordinal scores plus a continuous tie-break replace text theses
the common long-short decile portfolio replaces the paper's long-only equal-weight basket
invented_elements: the exact signed specialist feature mappings
neutral filling of missing specialist primitives
